meta.description: n8n only says WHEN. Arena does the work: generates and publishes the weekly project, closes and finalizes the week. No payload here ever carries a score. Contract: docs/backend/N8N_TRIGGER_ONLY.md

nodes.name: Sunday hourly 09:00-20:00 WIB
nodes.notes: Generate next week's projects as a preview. Publication is a separate, opening-time-gated job.

nodes.name: Hourly project publication
nodes.notes: Retry due weeks every hour. Arena enforces opening time and preview approval; already-open weeks are excluded.

nodes.name: Hourly week lifecycle
nodes.notes: Just past the Friday 23:59 WIB deadline. Close is deadline-gated and never forced from a timer.

nodes.name: Tell Arena to run it
nodes.notes: GET is correct: the jobs write, but access is gated by the bearer token, never by the method. neverError keeps a 4xx visible in the run log instead of aborting the branch.
